ios.desc:
Turn your photos into creative works of art with Photogenesis: Photo Art filters and effects.

Photogenesis is a digital photo playground where you can experiment with effects, styles, and colors and create your own stylised portrait art for saving, sharing, and printing. Tons of free effects. Unlock the Pro version which includes all effects and filters for just a small one-time charge. No subscriptions.

◆ No AI. You're in control.

Photogenesis puts you in the driver's seat for creating unique photo art. Tweak styles, colors, effects, parameters, everything! No AI and everything local on your device means your images stay 100% private, results are instant without loading, and you have full creative control. Just want to experiment and play? Swipe left and be surprised by random and interesting variations.

◆ Animated Effects

Watch artwork come to life with animated effects. Pause/restart and capture the perfect snapshot at any point in time to save/share/export.

◆ Uniquely inventive & creative filters

- Glitch art
- Pixelation and mosaic effects
- String art
- Shader art
- Abstract art
- Numerous tessellation patterns
- Halftone effects
- Flow field effects
- Kuwahara filtering
- Lots more!

Plus tons of useful photo editing tools for edge detection, image blurring, image background removal, warm/cool filters, contrast enhancement, and more.

◆ Stack Effects

Stack multiple effects to create something entirely unique, yours, and often quite surprising. Certain effects harmonize well to deliver incredible creative artworks.

◆ Support
Any questions? Contact us at support@photogenesis.app

quotes.text:
I've been working on https://www.photogenesis.app/

It's an iOS app that applies various generative art effects to your photos, letting you turn your photos into creative animated works of art. It's fully offline, no AI, no subscriptions, no ads, etc.

I'm really proud of it and if you've been in the generative art space for a while you'll instantly recognise many of the techniques I use (circle packing, line walkers, mosaic grid patterns, marching squares, voronoi tessellation, glitch art, string art, perlin flow fields, etc.) pretty much directly inspired by various Coding Train videos.

Direct download link on the App Store is https://apps.apple.com/us/app/photogenesis-photo-art/id6759713527 if you want to try it out.

* Coming to Android soon too.
